description: Gracefully restart a running service without redeploying. Use as first response when check_app_health returns unhealthy — fixes OOM, stuck processes, stale caches. Much faster and less disruptive than reset_service (which deletes and recreates the entire provider resource). On Cloud Run it is a new revision of the same build, not a deploy; a Vercel app runs on demand and has nothing to restart. For multi-service projects, use service_id to target a specific service.

service_id.description: Optional service ID for multi-service projects.

name: restart_service
